intro: Kuz's Skull is the severed head of Kuz, a prominent Razormane quilboar raider in the southern Barrens. Brought forward from Razorfen Kraul, Kuz helped orchestrate violent raids against Horde outposts before being targeted for death by a captive former kin.

p: The plains of the southern Barrens crawl with the Razormane tribe, but their organized aggression stems from specific leaders sent directly out of Razorfen Kraul. Kuz, alongside Nak and their ruthless chieftain Lok Orcbane, coordinated brutal incursions against travelers and settlements like the Crossroads. However, their internal treachery proved their undoing. Having betrayed their fellow quilboar Mangletooth and left him to rot in a cage at Camp Taurajo, they made a vengeful enemy. Mangletooth bartered Kuz's location to Horde champions willing to sever the raider's head and end his raids for good.
